subject: PulseHealth — request to approve short quote + logo badge for customer spotlight
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anita Suresh <anita.suresh@pulsehealth.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PulseHealth — request to approve short quote + logo badge for customer spotlight

Hi Anita —

Thanks again for giving us time during last week's enablement. We put together a very short customer spotlight draft (attached) that calls out the main outcomes from your team and includes a one-sentence quote we drafted from Dave's feedback.

Would PulseHealth be comfortable approving both: 1) the one-sentence quote (we propose: "Redwood Inference helped us cut inference latency by 60% while reducing cost per request"), and 2) use of the PulseHealth logo as a small lockup/badge in the marketing panel and on the case study landing page? We can publish only the quote (no logo) if you'd prefer.

Next steps we’re hoping for:
- Confirm final quote text (or give a short alternate)
- Confirm logo use and preferred logo file (or a link to brand guidelines)
- Any required legal/company language we should include

I've attached pulsehealth_case_study_draft_v2.pdf for your review — it's intentionally short so it can go live quickly. If it's easier, point us to whoever owns marketing/legal approval and we'll loop them in.

Appreciate it —

Marissa Cole
Senior Growth Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: pulsehealth_case_study_draft_v2.pdf

From: Anita Suresh <anita.suresh@pulsehealth.ai>

Cc: Dave Clifton <dave.clifton@pulsehealth.ai>, PulseHealth Legal <legal@pulsehealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PulseHealth — request to approve short quote + logo badge for customer spotlight

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — quick read and this looks good. We are fine with the overall framing but have two small asks before legal can sign off:

1) Can you change the quote to call out "latency for our recommendation engine" rather than a general "inference latency"? That makes the impact more specific.
2) Add a one-line attribution clause at the bottom of the page with our company name and a short opt-out line (we prefer: "Used with permission from PulseHealth; PulseHealth may request removal with 30 days' notice").

I've looped in our legal address here — either Dave or someone from legal will confirm final wording. We can also provide the SVG logo from brand if needed.

Best,
Anita
Head of Customer Marketing, PulseHealth

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the ping. Legal is okay with a very short, explicit permission like the proposed attribution line. Two small edits from our side:

1) Slight wording tweak to the quote to keep it tight and verifiable: "Redwood Inference reduced latency for our recommendation engine by ~60% while materially lowering per-request cost." The tilde signals an estimate; we can remove if PulseHealth prefers exact phrasing.

2) Attribution: change to "Used with permission from PulseHealth. PulseHealth may request removal within 30 days." — avoids the word "notice" which can complicate some legal workflows.

If Anita can confirm the quote wording and the simpler attribution, we are good to publish. Also request the final SVG (or a PNG at 2x) and any brand usage notes (clear space, minimum size).

Ben Carter
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

(Attachment: suggested_brand_attributes.txt)

Subject: Re: PulseHealth — request to approve short quote + logo badge for customer spotlight

Hi Marissa / Ben —

Thanks for iterating quickly. PulseHealth approves the following:

- Final quote (approved by Dave): "Redwood Inference reduced latency for our recommendation engine by ~60% while materially lowering per-request cost."
- Attribution text (approved by Legal): "Used with permission from PulseHealth. PulseHealth may request removal within 30 days."
- Logo: attaching final SVG and a high-res PNG for web (see attached). Please use the full-color horizontal logo; do not crop or alter.

I've attached a signed permission PDF (pulsehealth_permission_signed_20280719.pdf) that covers the quote and brand usage in the short-case spotlight and social promotion for the next 12 months. If you need a countersignature from Redwood, let me know and I'll route it.

Looking forward to the live link — and congrats to the team on a clean write-up.

Best,
Anita Suresh
Head of Customer Marketing, PulseHealth

Attachments: pulsehealth_permission_signed_20280719.pdf, pulsehealth_logo_horizontal.svg, pulsehealth_logo_web@2x.png
